title: Crash: NPE in HlsChunkSource.onPlaylistError
body:
I'm seeing small amount of crashes with callstack:
```
Fatal Exception: java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method 'boolean android.net.Uri.equals(java.lang.Object)' on a null object reference
       at com.google.android.exoplayer2.source.hls.HlsChunkSource.onPlaylistError(HlsChunkSource.java:406)
       at com.google.android.exoplayer2.source.hls.HlsSampleStreamWrapper.onPlaylistError(HlsSampleStreamWrapper.java:536)
       at com.google.android.exoplayer2.source.hls.HlsMediaPeriod.onPlaylistError(HlsMediaPeriod.java:455)
       at com.google.android.exoplayer2.source.hls.playlist.DefaultHlsPlaylistTracker.notifyPlaylistError(DefaultHlsPlaylistTracker.java:387)
       at com.google.android.exoplayer2.source.hls.playlist.DefaultHlsPlaylistTracker.access$800(DefaultHlsPlaylistTracker.java:46)
       at com.google.android.exoplayer2.source.hls.playlist.DefaultHlsPlaylistTracker$MediaPlaylistBundle.onLoadError(DefaultHlsPlaylistTracker.java:600)
       at com.google.android.exoplayer2.source.hls.playlist.DefaultHlsPlaylistTracker$MediaPlaylistBundle.onLoadError(DefaultHlsPlaylistTracker.java:462)
       at com.google.android.exoplayer2.upstream.Loader$LoadTask.handleMessage(Loader.java:492)
       at android.os.Handler.dispatchMessage(Handler.java:102)
       at android.os.Looper.loop(Looper.java:154)
       at android.os.HandlerThread.run(HandlerThread.java:61)
```

It does not look like issue with stream itself, since all the time when this crash happens stream is being played quite a long time:
